newsitem.title: JAPAN: WTO head urges '98 summit, fresh trade talks - Kyodo.
newsitem.headline: WTO head urges '98 summit, fresh trade talks - Kyodo.

text.p: The director-general of the World Trade Organisation (WTO), Renato Ruggiero, proposed holding a summit meeting of key members of the world trade watchdog in Geneva in May 1998 to underscore support for free trade, Kyodo news agency reported on Wednesday.

Kyodo quoted Foreign Ministry officials as saying Ruggiero told Foreign Minister Yukihiko Ikeda in a meeting late on Tuesday in Tokyo that the leaders of major developed and developing nations would issue a political message supporting free trade.

WTO member states' ministers would fix a schedule for the liberalisation of global trade toward the end of this century during the summit, which would mark the 50th anniversary of the WTO's predecessor, the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade (GATT), Ruggiero was quoted as saying.
The WTO chief also called for a new round of multilateral talks for trade liberalisation in agriculture, intellectual property rights, services, and investment and competition policy.
Ruggiero, who is visiting Japan through Sunday, is slated to meet Japanese farm and trade officials and business leaders.
